name: 定义 StorageUsage 领域对象
description: 实现 StorageUsage 存储用量 DTO struct，定义 project_id、used_bytes、quota_bytes、file_count、usage_percent 共 5 个字段，配置 JSON 序列化标签。提供 NewStorageUsage(projectId, usedBytes, quotaBytes, fileCount) 构造函数，自动计算 usage_percent = ceil(used_bytes * 100 / quota_bytes)。产出物：src/文件存储服务/models/storageusage.go
